invariants.rationale: The method will be called on a non-null data List, otherwise a NullPointerException would occur in the body.
func is dereferenced in the lambda wrapper, so it must be non-null.
A non-positive parallelism likely does not make sense for parallel streams, suggesting a contract that parallelism is positive.
If data is empty, parallelism does not influence the computation, so parallelism could be 1 in this degenerate case.
Since data is non-null and List supports stream(), this always yields a non-null Stream.
